channel.title: Saans | सांस — Air Quality Advisory & Action Feed
channel.description: Real-time evidence-grounded air quality alerts, diurnal ventilation windows, and respiratory advisories for Delhi-NCR winter smog.

item.title: Diurnal Ventilation Window Advisory: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM
item.description: Nocturnal temperature inversion lid is forecast to break around 1:00 PM today as solar heating destabilizes the surface layer. Recommended 15-20 minute cross-ventilation window reduces particulate influx by up to 45% compared to morning airing.

item.title: Protocol: Clean One Room Well for Bedroom Smog Protection
item.description: Step-by-step guidance on door bottom sealing and HEPA pre-purge to achieve sub-35 µg/m³ nocturnal bedroom air during severe GRAP Stage IV conditions.

item.title: Respiratory Protection: Certified N95 Sealed Nose Bridge vs Cloth Masks
item.description: Comparative filtration analysis: why cloth bandanas and loose surgical masks fail to protect against PM2.5, and how to verify an airtight respirator seal.
